capabilities: Highlight all occurrences of the selected text in the current note in real time
Clear highlights automatically when the selection is removed
Toggle whole-word-only matching versus substring matching
Set a custom highlight color in settings
extras: Matches inside rendered Markdown tables are not highlighted in Live Preview; the README recommends switching to Source mode for tables.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see all occurrences of a selected word or phrase in the current note without running a search.
summary: Editor plugin that automatically highlights every occurrence of the currently selected text in the active note, Notepad++ style.
